=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "TMR-PARAM", "section": "1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `W` from 4 to 32, and bits `W` and up of the `LOAD` and `COUNT` registers read as zero; a write to `LOAD` ignores them."},
    {"id": "TMR-RESET", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `CTRL`, `LOAD`, `COUNT` and `STATUS` clear to zero."},
    {"id": "TMR-REG-RW", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` stores `wdata` bits 2 to 0 in it, and a write to `LOAD` stores `wdata` bits `W-1` to 0 in it."},
    {"id": "TMR-READ", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "TMR-START", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where a write to `CTRL` sets `EN` and `EN` was 0, the count loads the `LOAD` value."},
    {"id": "TMR-COUNT", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is not zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the count falls by one."},
    {"id": "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` takes the place of that edge's count step: at that edge the count does not fall and the timer does not expire, whatever the count was."},
    {"id": "TMR-STOP", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` that clears `EN` stops the timer and the count keeps its value."},
    {"id": "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `LOAD` does not change the count: the new value is used at the next start or periodic reload."},
    {"id": "TMR-EXPIRE", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the timer expires: `EXPIRED` is set."},
    {"id": "TMR-PERIODIC", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In periodic mode an expiry also loads the count with the `LOAD` value, and `EN` stays 1."},
    {"id": "TMR-ONESHOT", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In one-shot mode an expiry also clears `EN`, and the count stays zero until the next start."},
    {"id": "TMR-W1C", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `STATUS` with bit 0 set clears `EXPIRED`, and with bit 0 clear changes nothing; it never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "TMR-SET-WINS", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A timer that expires at the same rising edge as a write that clears `EXPIRED` keeps `EXPIRED` set."},
    {"id": "TMR-IRQ", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when `EXPIRED` and `IE` are both 1, in one-shot and periodic mode alike; it follows the registers with no clock edge."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-param-width", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_param_width", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Build the testbench with W=4, W=16 and W=32. Write all-ones to LOAD, then read LOAD and COUNT (after a start). Check that bits W and up read as zero and that bits W-1..0 hold the written value. Run a short count and expiry at each W."},
    {"id": "T-reset", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_reset", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Program CTRL, LOAD and STATUS to non-zero values and let the timer count. Then hold rst_n low for one rising edge. Check that CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS all read zero. Repeat with reset asserted mid-count and right after an expiry."},
    {"id": "T-reg-rw", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_reg_rw", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW", "TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Write random wdata to CTRL and LOAD. Check that CTRL reads back wdata[2:0] with the other bits zero, and that LOAD reads back wdata[W-1:0] with the other bits zero. Write COUNT and check that it is unchanged."},
    {"id": "T-read-no-side-effect", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_read_no_side_effect", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "With we low, sweep addr across 0..3 between clock edges while the timer runs and EXPIRED is set. Check that rdata changes combinationally with addr in the same cycle, and that no register value (including EXPIRED) changes because of a read."},
    {"id": "T-start", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_start", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "Write LOAD=N, then write CTRL with EN=1 while EN was 0. Check that COUNT equals N right after that edge. Also write CTRL with EN=1 while EN is already 1, and check that the count does not reload."},
    {"id": "T-count", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_count_down", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "Start with LOAD=N and no further CTRL writes. Check that COUNT drops by exactly one per rising edge from N down to 0."},
    {"id": "T-write-wins", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_ctrl_write_wins", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "While counting, write CTRL (keeping EN=1) at an edge where the count is non-zero, and check that the count does not fall at that edge. Write CTRL at an edge where the count is zero and EN=1, and check that EXPIRED is not set and there is no reload or EN clear at that edge."},
    {"id": "T-stop", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_stop_holds", "proves": ["TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "Start the timer, then write CTRL with EN=0 mid-count. Check that COUNT holds its value over many edges and that no expiry occurs."},
    {"id": "T-load-late", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_load_late", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "While counting, write a new LOAD value and check that COUNT keeps counting from its current value. In periodic mode, check that the next reload uses the new value. In one-shot mode, check that the next start uses the new value."},
    {"id": "T-expire", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_expire", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Start with small LOAD values (including 0 and 1). Check that EXPIRED is set at the first edge where EN=1 and the count is 0 with no CTRL write, and not before."},
    {"id": "T-periodic", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_periodic", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "With MODE=1, run several periods. Check that at each expiry COUNT reloads to LOAD, EN stays 1 and EXPIRED is set. Check that the period is LOAD+1 edges."},
    {"id": "T-oneshot", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_oneshot", "proves": ["TMR-ONESHOT", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "With MODE=0, check that at expiry EN clears and COUNT stays 0 over many edges until CTRL is written with EN=1 again, which restarts from LOAD."},
    {"id": "T-w1c", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_status_w1c", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "With EXPIRED set, write STATUS with bit 0 clear and check that it stays set. Then write STATUS with bit 0 set and check that it clears. With EXPIRED clear, write STATUS=all-ones and check that it stays clear."},
    {"id": "T-set-wins", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_set_wins", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Arrange an expiry at edge k and write STATUS bit 0 = 1 at edge k, in both modes and with EXPIRED both previously set and previously clear. Check that EXPIRED is 1 after edge k."},
    {"id": "T-irq", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_irq", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Cover all four combinations of EXPIRED and IE in one-shot and periodic mode. Check that irq equals EXPIRED && IE in the same cycle as each register change, including toggling IE while EXPIRED is set."},
    {"id": "A-count-step", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_count_step", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "If EN && count!=0 && !(we && addr==0) holds at an edge, then count == $past(count)-1 at the next edge."},
    {"id": "A-ctrl-write-wins", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_ctrl_write_wins", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "If a CTRL write occurs at an edge, then that edge produces no decrement and no expiry. The count either holds or loads LOAD per TMR-START."},
    {"id": "A-start-load", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_start_load", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "A CTRL write with wdata[0]=1 while EN==0 implies count == $past(LOAD) after the edge."},
    {"id": "A-expire", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expire_set", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "If EN && count==0 && no CTRL write holds at an edge, then EXPIRED is set after it. In addition, MODE=1 implies count==$past(LOAD) and EN stays 1, and MODE=0 implies EN==0 and count==0."},
    {"id": "A-expired-only-by-expiry", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expired_rise_cause", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "A rise of EXPIRED implies that an expiry condition held at that edge. This shows that a STATUS write never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "A-set-wins", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_set_wins", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "If an expiry condition and a STATUS write with wdata[0]=1 occur at the same edge, then EXPIRED is 1 after it."},
    {"id": "A-irq", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_comb", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Immediate/concurrent check that irq == (EXPIRED && IE) at all times."},
    {"id": "A-reserved-zero", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_reserved_bits_zero", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM", "TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "rdata bits above the defined fields are zero for every addr: CTRL[31:3], LOAD and COUNT [31:W], and STATUS[31:1]."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
